items.question: What is the monthly storage fee under the Kestrel storage agreement?
items.answer:
The monthly storage fee under the Kestrel storage agreement is EUR 4,600. This amount is specified in Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement, which replaces the original monthly storage fee of EUR 4,000 [2].

The amendment became effective on 1 June 2026 [2].

evidence.quote: This Amendment takes effect on 1 June 2026

items.question: How much notice is needed to terminate the Kestrel storage agreement?
items.answer:
The Kestrel storage agreement requires sixty (60) days' written notice for termination. This is stated in the Kestrel Storage Services Agreement, which says: "Either party may terminate this Agreement on sixty (60) days' written notice" [1].

There is no indication that this clause has been amended.
